purpose: Separate concrete orthogonal grading data from the unproved analytic extension theorem.

nodes.title: Orthogonal grading and its weighted complement
nodes.statement_tex: An orthogonal grading consists of finitely many self-adjoint idempotents $P_i$ with $P_iP_j=0$ for distinct indices and $\sum_iP_i=\operatorname{id}$. For every real $s$, define $A(s)=\sum_i s^{i+1}P_i$ and $F_s=A(s)^{-1}(V^\perp)$ for a subspace $V$. These are data and total definitions, with no analytic-extension assertion.
nodes.status_note: Concrete data definitions contain no placeholders.
